title: Education Access
description: We help students overcome financial barriers that can interrupt their education — school fees, exam fees, books, and other verified needs. Headteachers verify each recipient, and donors receive updates every term.
teaser: Covering school fees, exam fees, and books so a financial gap doesn't end a student's year.
bullets: Needs-based support verified by headteachers and ward committees
Covers tuition, hostel, lab fees, books, and exam costs
Progress updates shared with donors each term
impact: Impact: 100+ students supported since 2023 with 95% year-over-year retention.

image.alt: A school community gathering at a partner school in Dhading, Nepal

title: Mentorship & Opportunity
description: Weekly calls and career conversations with Nepali mentors who understand the journey. Mentors help students see paths and possibilities beyond their immediate surroundings, and check in on attendance, grades, and goals.
teaser: Weekly calls and career conversations that connect students to guidance and possibilities beyond their village.
bullets: Weekly check-ins on attendance, grades, and personal goals
Career conversations with Nepali professionals, including in tech
Peer study groups and accountability circles
impact: Impact: 40+ mentors volunteering weekly to coach students across Dhading.

image.alt: Students and mentors gathered together in Dhading, Nepal

title: Digital Access
description: Many students in rural communities have little exposure to computers or modern learning tools. We work with partner schools to provide shared computer access, guided digital learning, and basic digital literacy — so students gain real exposure to technology and the paths it can open.
teaser: Shared computer access and guided digital learning so students gain real exposure to technology.
bullets: Shared computer labs at partner schools, with setup and maintenance support
Guided digital literacy sessions alongside regular coursework
Early exposure to technology careers and digital tools
impact: Impact: Shared computer access supported at 10+ partner classrooms since 2023.
